title: The Bakery of Junebug Creek
author: Isandro Blackwood
blurb: Lior Thackeray, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade before the festival ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
